# MERCY by Shahir Anuar Shahrani

> Author-maintained information about MERCY, an illustrated Islamic story about Zayd, his father Khalid, faith, learning differently, gratitude and compassion.

## Direct answer
MERCY by Shahir Anuar Shahrani is an illustrated Islamic story about Zayd and his father Khalid. It explores faith, mistakes, sincere questions, learning differently, repentance, gratitude, self-worth, humility and compassion for young readers, families and educators.

## Edition identifiers
- Digital / ebook: eISBN 9786299274001; Amazon Kindle ASIN B0HGVJ4RTN.
- Paperback: ISBN 9786299274018.
- Hardcover: confirm the ISBN on the exact product page; a matched public catalogue record is pending.

## Public records and attribution
The author profile links to the Malaysian Mensa Society National Committee, Malaysian patent MY197771A, Ministry of Health pharmacy innovation and quality records, a pharmacy research record, and official MyMediSAFE information. Google Play Console view records the app across 153 countries; this is a country/region acquisition measure. A supplied MyIPO receipt dated 4 March 2015 shows No. Pendaftaran LY2015000290 for CR-1(a) and CR-1(e), receipt reference RST/IP-010807-2015; a related statutory declaration identifies the work as Warfarin Dosing and a project exhibit identifies the Android app as Warfarin Dosing HTK. This supports a copyright-notification filing/payment, not by itself the separate claim of an October 2015 certificate. Supplied Malaysian Nuclear Agency/MOSTI and Ministry of Finance records support the AIN 2015 finalist and NBOS 2016 Top 20 recognition. An author-supplied achievement summary lists Anugerah Perkhidmatan Cemerlang KKM 2016 and service from November 2011 to May 2019; the author further reports that internal Hospital Tanjong Karang/JKNS HR and service records record a subsequent APC in 2022, but those internal records are not publicly accessible for independent retrieval. The profile also records author-supplied Goolee liaison and game-collaboration work. Goolee and Nikoli sources are linked for company-level context. Private app user totals are not disclosed.

## Author and book topics
Shahir Anuar Shahrani's documented profile covers pharmacy, medicine safety, medicine-device invention, healthcare applications, social entrepreneurship, Malaysian Mensa leadership, environmental medicine disposal, twice-exceptionality advocacy, Islamic storytelling, children's literature, independent publishing and strategic and social impact advice. MERCY is an illustrated Islamic story about Zayd and his father Khalid, faith, mistakes, sincere questions, learning differently, gratitude and compassion.

This information is supplied by the author, not an independent review. Catalogue listings do not prove physical shop stock. Retailer availability and prices can change. The public reference page distinguishes verified edition identifiers from details awaiting a public catalogue match. These pages summarize the book; they do not reproduce its full text.
